description: Street pointcloud HWN is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoh.conterra. Cyclomedia's Street LiDAR is a three-dimensional point cloud with a very high density. The collection of the point cloud takes place at the same time as the collection of the Cycloramas. Coverage: NL. Its keywords include lidar, point cloud, Geodata, hoofdwegennet, cyclorama, puntenwolk. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
